purpose: Staged desktop terminal tab on This Mac; not signed installed-app acceptance
checks: palette opens a shell on This Mac over the Unix socket
typed keystrokes reach the shell and the daemon retains its output
Cmd+C through the Edit menu and right-click Copy both copy the terminal selection
Cmd+V pastes through the native paste event
reload restores the tab and reattaches the same shell
Cmd+W closes the tab and ends the shell
